summary: The note describes the Free State of Brunswick, a state of the German Reich during the Weimar Republic. It was created after the Duchy of Brunswick was abolished during the German Revolution of 1918–19, and its capital was Braunschweig (Brunswick).
one_line: Free State of Brunswick: a Weimar-era German Reich state formed from the former Duchy of Brunswick after the 1918–19 revolution.
key_facts: The Free State of Brunswick was a state of the German Reich in the time of the Weimar Republic.
The Free State of Brunswick was formed after the abolition of the Duchy of Brunswick.
The formation of the Free State of Brunswick occurred in the course of the German Revolution of 1918–19.
The capital of the Free State of Brunswick was Braunschweig (Brunswick).
